issues: Modal does not dismiss on Escape key — only via the X button. Minor UX nit, documented in iteration_1 for event/alert modals as well; now generalised to new modals.

action_items: Investigate webpack-dev-server HMR stall: Layout.jsx (containing the new MITRE/Intel/Playbooks NAV entries) did NOT appear in the served bundle.js until I manually `touch`ed the file after a supervisor restart. If this repeats, main agent should either (a) run `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` + `touch src/components/Layout.jsx` after any sidebar NAV edit, or (b) wire a Webpack `watchOptions.poll` in craco/webpack config to make file watching reliable in this container (inotify is sometimes unreliable on overlayfs).
Optional UX: close modals on Escape key for all shadcn/custom Modal wrappers (`/app/frontend/src/components/Modal.jsx`).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is now 1115 lines — long overdue to split into routers (auth, events, rules, alerts, indicators, mitre, playbooks, investigations, reports, settings, admin). Growing fast.

`/api/indicators/scan` uses `evaluate_rule` only against detection_rules with rule_type=='indicator'. If no such enabled rule exists for a given org, scan returns 0 regardless of how many active IOCs exist. Fine today (seed creates one), but is implicit — consider either auto-creating an org-wide 'IOC Match' rule in seed, or scanning indicators directly bypassing rule_type filter.

playbooks.execute(): dry_run approval branch marks approval-gated steps as `status='simulated'` which is correct, but the record['status'] computation on line 180 only accepts {ok, simulated}. If a non-approval step errors on a dry run it will be flagged needs_approval instead of failed — rename state to 'completed' only when all are 'ok' and no error occurred.
playbooks.execute(): `enrich_iocs` only considers `alert['src_ip']` — URLs/hashes/domains from the alert's related_events are ignored. Low-impact today but mentioned for completeness.

indicator_hits regex uses `^v$` anchored match with $options=i — correct, but doesn't match events where the IP is embedded in `raw` or logged under a non-standard key. Acceptable for synthetic data; document limitation.
mitre_coverage computes coverage per enabled rule only (as required). Good. Sub-technique parent is auto-covered when any sub covered — matches ATT&CK conventions.
No pagination on `/api/indicators` beyond `.limit(1000)` and `/api/playbooks/executions` beyond `.limit(100)` — ok for synthetic workspace; flag for prod scale.
Known Milestone-1 hydration warning in Reports.jsx (<span> inside <option>) still present. Carry-over.

rca of the issue: RCA (resolved during testing): Initial frontend check showed sidebar missing MITRE ATT&CK, Threat Intel, and Playbooks nav items even though Layout.jsx on disk included them and routes resolved correctly when visited directly. Diffed the live bundle.js served at /static/js/bundle.js — the NAV array in the compiled JS lacked those 3 entries, confirming the webpack dev server had not recompiled Layout.jsx after the Milestone-2 edit. Reproduction: curl the bundle and grep for 'MITRE ATT' — count was 1 (only Mitre.jsx PageHead title) before fix, 2 after. Mitigation: `touch /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx` triggered an HMR rebuild; after 8s the bundle contained the new nav labels and the sidebar rendered all 12 items. Root cause is inotify watch flakiness on container overlayfs — not an app code bug.
